# SitPanda
> Free, fast, and accurate online calculators for finance, health, and everyday life.

## Calculators
- [Home](https://sitpanda.com/): Directory of all available tools.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://sitpanda.com/mortgage-calculator.html): Home loan EMI estimator.
- [Loan Calculator](https://sitpanda.com/loan-calculator.html): Personal, auto, student, and business loan EMI.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://sitpanda.com/compound-interest-calculator.html): Investment growth and savings estimator.
- [Salary Calculator](https://sitpanda.com/salary-calculator.html): Hourly, daily, weekly, and annual pay converter.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://sitpanda.com/inflation-calculator.html): Purchasing power and CPI estimator.
